info.title: FScript CLI
info.description: Command-line interface for running FScript programs with sandboxed filesystem externs and script arguments.

options.name: --root
options.description:
Override sandbox root directory for filesystem
externs.

options.name: --config
options.description:
Override automatic fscript.toml selection with an
explicit configuration.

options.name: --debug-adapter
options.description:
Run the Debug Adapter Protocol service (used by
editor integrations).

options.name: --debug-capabilities
options.description: Report the CLI debugger protocol capabilities as JSON.

options.name: --no-result
options.description:
Do not display the final program value; explicit
output and evaluation are preserved.

options.name: --no-config
options.description:
Disable automatic fscript.toml loading (script
directory, or cwd for stdin/REPL).

options.name: --no-default-externs
options.description:
Disable default runtime externs from
FScript.Runtime.Registry.

options.name: --extern-assembly
options.description:
Load external-function providers from an assembly
path (repeatable).
